question: Find the display name of the user who owns the most valuable post (by FavoriteCount) that has a corresponding entry in postHistory created in 2010. Then, compute the percentage difference between the proportion of 'Student' badges this user earned in 2010 versus 2011, considering only badges from these two years.

prediction.sql:
WITH top_post_user AS (
    SELECT u.XCL_052 AS user_id, u.XCL_055 AS display_name
    FROM posts p
    INNER JOIN users u ON p.XCL_033 = u.XCL_052
    INNER JOIN postHistory ph ON p.XCL_026 = ph.XCL_014
    WHERE strftime('%Y', ph.XCL_016) = '2010'
    ORDER BY p.XCL_039 DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
badge_stats AS (
    SELECT
        b.XCL_002 AS user_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', b.XCL_004) = '2010' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_2010,
        SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', b.XCL_004) = '2010' AND b.XCL_003 = 'Student' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS student_2010,
        SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', b.XCL_004) = '2011' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_2011,
        SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', b.XCL_004) = '2011' AND b.XCL_003 = 'Student' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS student_2011
    FROM badges b
    WHERE strftime('%Y', b.XCL_004) IN ('2010', '2011')
    GROUP BY b.XCL_002
)
SELECT
    tpu.display_name,
    ((bs.student_2010 * 1.0 / NULLIF(bs.total_2010, 0)) - (bs.student_2011 * 1.0 / NULLIF(bs.total_2011, 0))) * 100 AS percentage_difference
FROM top_post_user tpu
INNER JOIN badge_stats bs ON tpu.user_id = bs.user_id

WITH top_post_user AS (
    SELECT u.XCL_052 AS user_id, u.XCL_055 AS display_name
    FROM posts p
    INNER JOIN users u ON p.XCL_033 = u.XCL_052
    INNER JOIN postHistory ph ON p.XCL_026 = ph.XCL_014
    WHERE strftime('%Y', ph.XCL_016) = '2010'
    ORDER BY p.XCL_039 DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
badge_stats AS (
    SELECT
        b.XCL_002 AS user_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', b.XCL_004) = '2010' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_2010,
        SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', b.XCL_004) = '2010' AND b.XCL_003 = 'Student' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS student_2010,
        SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', b.XCL_004) = '2011' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_2011,
        SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', b.XCL_004) = '2011' AND b.XCL_003 = 'Student' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS student_2011
    FROM badges b
    WHERE strftime('%Y', b.XCL_004) IN ('2010', '2011')
    GROUP BY b.XCL_002
)
SELECT
    tpu.display_name,
    ((bs.student_2010 * 1.0 / NULLIF(bs.total_2010, 0)) - (bs.student_2011 * 1.0 / NULLIF(bs.total_2011, 0))) * 100 AS percentage_difference
FROM top_post_user tpu
INNER JOIN badge_stats bs ON tpu.user_id = bs.user_id
